# Native provider adaptation

`dsh-cua.js` and `dsh-cua-macos.js` are derived from the published DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2 packages under the adjacent MIT license. The local adaptation exposes a per-Agent capture callback that uses the existing native connection and application access check. A per-agent request queue prioritizes targeted operations, which cancel an active preview and wait for its native cleanup; otherwise it alternates waiting preview and foreground requests. The configured native timeout covers both queue wait and dispatch, with the existing cleanup grace applied when cancellation needs native acknowledgement. Captures are included in provider cleanup, and marks captures display-only so neither the Host nor the native helper changes the model's screenshot-coordinate state. Loader volatile updates are observed on the owning entry so revoked grants cancel access and clear previews. The provider exports its own configuration and service requirements; `@deepseek-ai/dsh-cua` supplies the configuration type.

The PTC bridge is bundled from the paired Core checkout with `node scripts/sync-cua-bridge.mjs <core-checkout>`; its provenance records the Core base commit and source hashes. Packaging verifies the resulting bridge hash. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-cua` still supplies the configuration type. Update the provider adaptations and tests together when changing their source version.
